findings.impact: On one continuous straight affine segment with monotone outside-to-inside predicate, adjacency bisection is sound. With floating predicate holes or a discontinuous segment endpoint, it proves a local adjacent outside/inside crossing only; not earliest point over all earlier representable times.

discrete_time.sound_for_bracket: Begin is known outside, accepted high is checked inside, midpoint reduces bracket until representable equality; candidate At is checked >Begin and <=End. Therefore helper does not deliberately force Next, insert epsilon, replay Wake, or move native clock backward.
discrete_time.native_gate: Next loop pumps actual InputAt at returned cursor; kernel can still reject geometry/LOS/liveness or queue rather than wake. Kernel owns deadline WakeAt+1.
discrete_time.time_domain: Actual ValidFrame admits finite nonnegative times and exact endpoints; midpoint uses a difference to avoid normal positive-time addition overflow. /fp:fast and subnormal/extreme values are not covered by the normal scalar proof.
discrete_time.not_guaranteed: Duplicating the ellipse source expression in separately optimized TUs does not establish bitwise predicate equivalence under /fp:fast. Native kernel witness is authoritative.
